```plato
    // About `count` points of the named strategy over the region. The families
    // whose count is an input honour it exactly; the grid families report the
    // cells of the nearest grid, and Poisson-disk reports whatever its radius
    // saturated at. The strategies that carry no randomness ignore the seed.
    PatternPoints2D(pattern: SamplePattern, region: Bounds2D, count: Integer,
        seed: Integer): Array<Point2D>
        => match (pattern) {
            RegularGrid => JitteredGridPoints2D(region, PatternGrid(region, count), 0.0, seed);
            JitteredGrid => JitteredGridPoints2D(region, PatternGrid(region, count), 1.0, seed);
            Stratified => StratifiedPoints2D(region, PatternGrid(region, count), 1, seed);
            PoissonDisk => PoissonDiskPoints2D(region, BlueNoiseRadius(region, count), 30, seed);
            Halton => HaltonPoints2D(region, count, 2, 3);
            Hammersley => HammersleyPoints2D(region, count, 2);
            Sobol => SobolPoints2D(region, count, 1);
            Plastic => PlasticPoints2D(region, count, 0.5);
            BlueNoise => BlueNoisePoints2D(region, count, seed);
        };
```
